experiments.study_type: Cisplatin cytotoxicity drug treatment of U87 glioma cuboids in microfluidic device
experiments.procedure_text: U87 glioma cuboids cultured in device treated with graded cisplatin concentrations for 2 days; viability assessed by SYTOX green/Hoechst fluorescence ratio.
experiments.procedure_text_evidence: we exposed U87 cuboids in the device with different concentrations of a cytotoxic chemotherapy drug, cisplatin
experiments.route_evidence: we treated two wells with each concentration of cisplatin

endpoints.label: cell viability / cytotoxicity (SYTOX green dead stain)
endpoints.evidence: As a straightforward, simple measure of cell viability

experiments.exposure_evidence: with each concentration of cisplatin (0, 10, 30, 100 μM) for 2 days from day 1 to day 3
experiments.notes: Cuboids derived from U87 cell-line xenograft tumors; this assay performed in vitro on cultured cuboids, so species coded null for cell-line-derived system.
